hypothesis: Blending 20% point-in-time ROE percentile into the existing VCP and turnover score should prioritize profitable companies when simultaneous breakouts compete for portfolio slots without introducing a survivorship or announcement-date lookahead.
trial_note: Only point-in-time ROE ranking changes relative to the stop5 protocol. Financial observations are selected strictly before the signal date; entry thresholds, exits, costs, slots and the development interval remain frozen.
